Documentation.UserDocu: Feature for creating and manipulating Technical Drawing section views

getCutPieces() - the result of the section cut, in the global frame and before centering, scaling and rotating. The shape carries element names: the face made by the cut is named from the cutting tool's SectionPlane face, so it keeps its name when the model changes or SectionOrigin moves.

getCuttingTool() - the tool this section cuts with, with the element names its faces carry (SectionPlane, SectionBack and the four sides). Rebuilt on demand from the current section plane and the size of the last cut input.
